token_near_graduation.meaning: the LaunchToken is near its graduation, approaching BONDING_SUPPLY

pair_precreated_by_attacker.meaning: the (token,quote) UniSwapV2 pair was created by the attacker before graduation by supplying the LaunchToken and quote addresses

token_transfer_restricted.meaning: LaunchToken cannot be transferred until graduation and can only be moved by the launchpad and GTE router

graduation_completed.meaning: the graduation transaction completes without reverting, depositing 20% of the token and all held quoteReserve into the UniSwapV2 pool

users_forced_to_pull_quote.meaning: users holding quote are forced to pull out all of their quote

assumptions: The attacker's pair creation and 1 wei deposit/sync occur before the graduation transaction.
The graduation path invokes uniV2Router.addLiquidity against the pre-created (token,quote) pair.
Users hold quote in the launchpad and their quote is returned/pulled when graduation cannot complete.

unresolved.description: Report does not state whether the attacker is permissionless/unauthorized for pair creation; only that an attacker can deploy the pair and deposit.
Report gives no numeric definition of 'near graduation' / approaching BONDING_SUPPLY, so the proximity condition is a grounded Boolean.

limitations: The 20% token / all quoteReserve deposit amounts are stated in the intent but not encoded as numeric quantities because the selected impact is the forced quote pull-out, not a value-amount relation.
Permanence of the DoS depends on the asserted _assertValidRecipient restriction, which is not independently verified.
The impact is potential; the plan formalizes the reported forbidden outcome, not its truth.
